description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment  to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2016/22 of 25.04.2017, Ratmalana D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 521001 and other  amendments
reasoning: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains multiple entries detailing specific modifications to land parcel records, including changes to parcel numbers, extents, encumbrances, and location descriptions for various land parcels in different districts. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" and focuses entirely on land title settlement matters, making it a clear example of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) which covers land registrations, property ownership, and land title amendments.
